item.title: Poirot's Rule: A Hard Agatha Christie Cryptogram
item.description:
Captain Hastings has spotted something odd, and he’s decided it doesn’t matter. He says so out loud, to Poirot, which is a mistake. A groan comes from the little Belgian, followed by two short sentences. Every Christie fan has met the idea behind them, even if they couldn’t quote the words.

This is the hard one: no free letter. Every letter is swapped for a different one, the swap holds throughout, and no letter stands for itself. You start with nothing but the shapes of the words, and the shapes turn out to be enough.
